prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: have in-depth knowledge ranging from mechatronic system design to computer-aided manufacturing of mechanical or mechatronic system components;
are able to quantitatively describe and analyze simple thermodynamic phenomena and processes;
have basic knowledge for describing and analyzing the dynamics of individual rigid bodies and simple flexible bodies. They possess knowledge about the structure and behavior of multi-body systems.

syllabus_topics: D	Alembert's principle in Lagrange's formulation
Dynamics of rigid and flexible bodies
Definition of basic concepts (system, state and process variables)
1st and 2nd law of thermodynamics and their application
Ideal gases as well as real substances and mixtures
